from.description: The account `sideby next` runs in (SIDEBY_ACCOUNT, set by sideby for the sessions it starts), when it belongs to this family.

pick.description: The recommended account; null when none can be used now (exit code 1).

state.description: ready and unknown can be picked; api only with --include-api; logged-out never. full (a window at or past its own Takeover Limit: 5-hour windows the handoff threshold - 10, windows longer than a day the threshold) only as a Last Resort: when no subscription account is ready or unknown, the one with the lowest limitUse and no window used up, and `tight` is set.

pressure.description: Used percent of the fullest window not reset yet; null without quota.

limitUse.description: Limit Use: the percent of its own Takeover Limit that the closest window has used (a weekly 87% under 95 is 91.6); null without quota. Ready accounts rank by it, lowest first.

limit.description: This window's Takeover Limit in percent.

window.description: The window closest to its own Takeover Limit; absent when none is open.

resetsAt.description: For full: when it is usable again. With a window used up, when those windows reset; otherwise when every window is under its Takeover Limit again.

observedAt.description: When the account's quota was recorded (its last session).

quotaFrom.description: The account the quota was read from, when it is another account of the same login.

sameLoginAs.description: The current account (`from`), when this one is signed in as the same login: it shares that quota and is never picked.

accounts.description: Every account of the family, best first.

hasQuota.description: False when no account has quota data: the pick is then a guess, and `sideby next` does not start it (exit 1).

limit.description: The Takeover Limit of 5-hour windows in percent (handoff threshold - 10).

longLimit.description: The Takeover Limit of windows longer than a day in percent (the handoff threshold).

tight.description: Set when the pick is a Last Resort: every subscription account has a window at or past its Takeover Limit, and the pick is the one with the lowest limitUse and no window used up.

earliestReset.description: Set when nothing can be picked and some accounts are full (every one has a window used up): the first to come back.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
